acceptance.gate: Phase 6 gate G6 per master-plan v2.1 10.1: two-block elastic collision
acceptance.min_gap_lower_bound: contact must engage (min gap < 0) without excessive penetration
acceptance.rebound_note: identical masses, elastic: velocities exchange (upper 0, lower v0); penalty contact is near-elastic, rebound checked qualitatively via energy bound

contact.law: linear penalty on penetration, updated per step
contact.type: direct Python penalty on surface-layer nodes (Kratos high-level contact processes cannot init on QP models: S22, S25)

model.blocks: 2x p=1 1x1x1 IGA blocks + Triangle3D3 surface layers tied by LinearMasterSlaveConstraint
model.boundary: free-free (no fixed DOFs, no external loads)

review_note: 2026-11-17 review: spec is internally inconsistent - model.degree = 2 (master-plan v2.1 V-EXP-C: p 2) but model.blocks says p=1 and the test uses p=1 blocks; contact.penalty_stiffness_per_pair = 2000 but the test uses k_pen = 500. Values left unchanged pending a user decision.
title: Two-block free-free elastic collision (explicit, penalty contact)
